title: QGI Stage 6 Shape Prototype Lock File
description: Per-recipe canonical shape prototype lock per Stage 6 pre-reg (qgi-docs commit e4f9e7a) §4.3. Production shape-feature emits MUST consult this artifact at run-start, SHA-verify the file content, and pin the prototype SHA in every result JSON. Prototype rotation requires F-H-4 amendment + Lakatosian guard F-Shape-1 (§6.2) + 8-seat ratification.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Loader raises on any other value (forward-compat guard).

filed.description: YYYY-MM-DD date this artifact was filed.

purpose.description: Free-text statement of artifact purpose; reproduced verbatim per §4.3 spec.

stage_6.description: Commit SHA of Stage 6 pre-reg merge in qgi-docs.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical-serialized JSON content of THIS file with metadata.file_sha256 cleared to the empty string. Loader recomputes and verifies on load; mismatch raises PrototypeIntegrityError.

n_recipes_with_prototype.description: Count of recipes with a fitted prototype entry.

n_recipes_substrate_inadequate.description: Count of recipes whose G1-G4 substrate gates failed; these are routed to ingredient+length fallback.

fit_method_commit_sha.description: qgi-ml commit SHA at which the fit method was run.

fpca_component_scores.description: LKJ posterior mean of μ_r in FPCA score space (the Bayesian prototype location). Per Sonnet B4 (2026-05-17): NOT the near-zero training-score sample mean.

posterior_cov_diag.description: Per-time-step diagonal of the trajectory-space Mahalanobis denominator. Per Sonnet B5 + Priya adjudication (2026-05-17): back-projected LKJ posterior-mean Σ_r through V_r then Phi.

cov_diag_source.description: Provenance tag for posterior_cov_diag (Lloyd's audit surface). Expected value: 'posterior_mean_lkj_back_projected' (FPCA primary) or 'posterior_gp_f_r_empirical_cov_diag' (GP fallback). Optional for backwards compatibility with pre-B5 emissions.

gp_fallback_variant.description: F-H-4-A1 + F-H-4-A3 amendment provenance (qgi-docs 2026-05-18 / 2026-05-19, each 8-seat ratified). Present only on GP-fallback indicator signatures. 'v2_no_instance_gp' = post-F-H-4-A1 §3.1.4 model without g_c^(k), with InvGamma(2,1) on ell_recipe. 'v3_no_instance_gp_lognormal_ell' = post-F-H-4-A3 model with ell_recipe ~ LogNormal(log(1.5), 0.5) to address SE-kernel saturation multimodality at T_r=5 (Rasmussen & Williams 2006 §5.4.5; Stein 1999 §2.7). New emissions after the F-H-4-A3 merge MUST use 'v3_no_instance_gp_lognormal_ell'.

gp_fallback_amendment.description: F-H-4 amendment ID under which this GP-fallback prototype was fit. Expected value: 'F-H-4-A1' for post-2026-05-18 GP-fallback emissions. Optional for backwards compatibility with pre-amendment emissions (which never reached fit completion due to PyTensor kernel-argument crash).
